description: Closed vocabulary of dataset shapes carried in disease-insights manifests. Manifest entries' `type` field must be one of these ids.

items.label: Keyword clusters
items.description: Indication-scoped cluster set in the keyword-lexicon shape (id, label, description, indication, parent_theme, parent_subtheme, variants[]). Suggestion fuel for the autotag pipeline.

items.label: Search-volume topics
items.description: Topic-by-volume table (typically estimated monthly or aggregate query volume). Dimensions: topic. Measures: volume.

items.label: Patient community engagement
items.description: Engagement metrics for patient communities (e.g. Facebook groups), grouped by community type. Dimensions: group_type. Measures: avg_membership, avg_monthly_posts.

items.label: Digital ad spend time series
items.description: Monthly digital ad spend per branded domain. Dimensions: domain, month. Measures: estimated_spend.
